DML.SELECT: SELECT scenario_id as "id", element_type_id as "elementTypeId", element_id as "elementId", n_order as "nOrder", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM conf.cctv_scenario_elements WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.cctv_scenario_elements (scenario_id, element_type_id, element_id, n_order, enabled, visible) VALUES (:id , :elementTypeId , :elementId , :nOrder , :enabled , :visible)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE conf.cctv_scenario_elements SET element_type_id = :elementTypeId, element_id = :elementId, n_order = :nOrder, enabled = :enabled, visible = :visible WHERE scenario_id = :id
